g.text: Historical A3 P8+D8: percentage change at matched concurrency

text.style: font-size: 10px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: middle; fill: #536471

g.text: Historical candidates include KDA o_proj TP; these are not current pure KDATP results.
Change = (candidate / baseline - 1) x 100%; only measured matched-concurrency points are plotted.
No interpolated baseline; candidate-only concurrency points are omitted. SLO gains are reported separately in the PR table.
4096 input / 1024 output; MTP5; PrefixCache enabled; recurrent state remains on DP owners.
